body:
Build: `pnpm --filter <pkgname> build` (@filemark/mdx, @filemark/csv, @filemark/chart, chrome-ext...); root Taskfile has `task build`/`build:ext`/`zip`. Typecheck: `cd <dir> && pnpm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit; vscode runs BOTH tsconfig.json + tsconfig.webview.json). Tests: `cd <dir> && pnpm test` (vitest run); build dependency packages first before a consumer bundle picks them up.
Name<->directory mismatches (bit me): @filemark/csv lives in packages/csv-viewer/; the website package is @filemark/website-new (NOT "website" — `pnpm --filter website` finds nothing); apps/vscode name is `filemark`, apps/chrome-ext is `chrome-ext`.
Test conventions: default vitest env is NODE (fast, no DOM/vscode); files src/**/*.test.ts; DOM suites opt into jsdom via `// @vitest-environment jsdom`. React component rendering is verified by BUILD/typecheck, NOT by component tests — so extract pure logic (pickPreviewRenderer, buildFolderHandleMap, parseVideo) and unit-test that; don't render components in vitest. Chart package has no test script (typecheck+build is its gate). Debug via src/, never the minified bundle.
